laws.rule: Mount Rinjani National Park climbing tickets for foreign visitors, from 3 November 2025: IDR 250,000 per day (about A$19.56, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) on the Sembalun, Senaru and Torean routes and IDR 200,000 (about A$15.65) on Aikberik, Tetebatu and Timbanuh.
laws.heading: Balai Taman Nasional Gunung Rinjani, under Minister of Forestry Regulation 17/2025

sources.title: Kenaikan Kelas dan Tarif Tiket Pendakian Gunung Rinjani

local-law.note: Route openings change with fire and weather closures; check the park before booking.
